source.text:
Hi there,

I'm Gary, technical founder building a workflow orchestration app for software development to manage hundreds of Claude Code sessions. I'm preparing for a product launch and would love to practice pitching and conducting customer interviews with other software professionals. In return, I'm happy to help you practice your pitch and test out your product and provide honest product feedback.

If you're interested, leave a comment or go ahead and put a calendar invite on my calendar here: https://calendar.app.google/V8deGmGsmiC8Ch9a7

Best,

Gary
source.title: Ask HN: Any founders want to trade pitch practice and customer interviews?
